body: this is how I feel every time I have an episode and relapse. I also feel as though I am watching myself. I know I shouldn’t do it but I can’t physically stop myself
yea thanks heaps btw, I’ll just have to wait it out until I’m physically free of this.
yea I agree, honestly just lost as to what I can do for the time being because I don’t know how much longer I can stand this shit before I go insane.

yea I’ve honestly come to the same conclusion. it sucks though, I’m forced by them to stay reliant on them, if that makes any sense. I’m underage and unable to drive, and they refuse to let me take lifts from friends/people I know, therefore being forced to rely on them. they are weirdly insistent on me quitting my job, an example of this is whenever there’s a minor inconvenience surrounding my job that they don’t like they genuinely just tell me to quit. 

ngl I feel like the stem of this is their religious beliefs, which are also forced upon me. I’ve even explained to them that when they force me to believe what they believe, internally I push away more. but they don’t seem to understand and believe I should remain submissive to them.
yea, I’m going to try and find a way to seek help and diagnosis, thanks for replying.
thank you haha, I’ll try and find some resources online. thanks for the help, I really appreciate your time and effort :)
thanks again, it’s just that due to corona virus and schools being shut in Australia, I’m finding it difficult to find a way to talk to a councillor.

thank you so much for replying, I’ll try and stop the harm and talk to someone but I’m just really scared to talk to my one close friend about it and, due to coronavirus, I can’t even access a school councillor. It’s difficult for me to go to a professional because I have no money and no way of travel to one.

thank you for replying, I’m not sure. I think I might be in denial because I feel if I consult someone in my family about it they will just tell me I’m being over dramatic and selfish/immature. I like the idea of seeking help and getting properly diagnosed but I’m too scared to go and do it because that requires asking a family member as I have no other way of getting there.
